# University of Brighton Research Portal

> A comprehensive research database and institutional portal showcasing faculty profiles, research outputs, and collaborative projects across the University of Brighton.

The University of Brighton research portal serves as a centralized hub for discovering researcher profiles, tracking research projects, and mapping institutional collaborations. It provides access to research outputs and facilitates connections between academic groups across the university's schools and departments.

## Key Topics

- Research Portal
- Researcher Profiles
- Research Outputs

## Research Portal & Directory

- [University of Brighton Research Portal Home](https://research.brighton.ac.uk): Main entry point to the University of Brighton research database with researcher profiles and institutional outputs
- [Research Database Home](https://research.brighton.ac.uk/en/home): University of Brighton research database and researcher directory for discovering faculty and research initiatives
- [Research Portal Index](https://research.brighton.ac.uk/en/home/index): Research portal with collaboration tracking and comprehensive institutional research information

## Institutional Profiles

- [University of Brighton Organization Profile](https://research.brighton.ac.uk/en/organisations/university-of-brighton): University of Brighton research profile displaying faculty, research projects, and institutional structure

## Support & Information

- [Contact Information](https://research.brighton.ac.uk/en/contact/index): Contact form and support information for the University of Brighton research portal
- [Web Accessibility Statement](https://research.brighton.ac.uk/en/web-accessibility): WCAG compliance and accessibility statement ensuring screen reader compatibility and inclusive access
